    1. acceptsJsonSchemaResponseFormat(ChatModel)

Interface JsonSchemaResponseFormatSupport

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface JsonSchemaResponseFormatSupport
Identifies chat models that accept a JSON schema response format on each request although they do not declare Capability.RESPONSE_FORMAT_JSON_SCHEMA.

LangChain4j only sends a JSON schema to models declaring the capability, and otherwise appends format instructions to the user message. Google AI Gemini, for example, honors the response format of the request but declares the capability only when a JSON response format is configured on the model. For the models identified here, the AI services and agents returning a type with a generated schema use the structured output of the model.

Provider modules register a bean for their models; the langchain4j.structured-output.force-json-schema-response-format property overrides them.

Since:
2.4.0
